bio.text: Eric Jones, a Democrat, is a candidate for California's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.

He holds a bachelor's degree from Yale University and was a partner at Dragoneer Investment Group; he and his wife founded the Rachel and Eric Jones Foundation, and he co-founded the American Dream Institute.
According to his campaign website, he is raising two children in Napa and his story begins in rural Maine, where his mother was a nurse.
